rules.name: Maximum Charge Rate
rules.description: Standard maximum charge rate under nominal conditions is 1.0C.

rules.name: Cold Charging Restraint
rules.description: Charging below 0C must be throttled to 0.1C to prevent dendrite formation.

rules.name: SoC Tapering Regulation
rules.description: Reduce charging rate to 0.25C above 80% SoC to avoid overpotential.
